I’ve been single-blade shaving for about 5 years. I enjoy trying out different blades and soaps. This is one of my stand-byes so I can recommend this soap.  1. SHAVE: EXCELLENT.  Mitchell’s is very slick and leaves very little tendency to cut or scrape. It results in a close, smooth shave in two passes. Most premium soaps result in a good-to-excellent shave.  2. SKIN: EXCELLENT. This product contains lanolin and results in the very best and softest after-shave experience of any soap I’ve tried.

Some time ago, the company from whom I had purchased shaving soap for many years, discontinued their product, leaving me to search for a new soap.  As a result, I tried a number of different products with unsatisfactory results.  Some had a scent I didn't like, none lasted more than 30 days and some were gone in two weeks, or produced unsatisfactory lather.  Then I stumbled onto this soap.  I have been a mug shaver for more than 50 years and this may well be the best I have ever used.  No scent.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the soap for producing a slick, smooth, comfortable shave with good cushion and glide.
Several reviewers note the soap is finicky or difficult to lather, especially with hard water, where lather can dissipate.
Reviewers frequently highlight the lanolin and post-shave moisturizing, non-drying feel as a key benefit.
Some reviewers find the soap long-lasting and good value, while a few feel there are better soaps for the money.
A small number of reviewers raise negative concerns, including a scent complaint and an ingredient safety claim.
